approved.en: Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy facilities, including a strike that killed 17 in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal, prompting Ukraine to call the claim false after further strikes. The Houthi movement launched a second missile attack on Riyadh airport, killing a Pakistani national and wounding several people, leading Saudi Arabia to extend airport suspensions. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland fortsetter luftangrep på ukrainske energianlegg, inkludert et angrep som drepte 17 i Zaporizjzja, mens Ukraina sier at de vil pause sine egne raffineriangrep dersom Russland stopper sine energiangrep. President Trump kunngjorde et påstått Russland-Ukraina energivåpenhvile knyttet til en dieselforhandling, noe som fikk Ukraina til å erklære påstanden falsk etter ytterligere angrep. Houthiene lanserte et andre missilangrep mot Riyadh flyplass, der en pakistansk nasjonal ble drept og flere personer ble såret, noe som førte til at Saudi-Arabia forlenget suspensjonen av flyplassen. 75 767 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise thorough investigations. In northern Israel, Hezbollah submunitions exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing the teen and wounding dozens, prompting the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. The conflict has produced 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i Sør-Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi missiles have struck Riyadh airport repeatedly, killing twelve and wounding many, prompting Saudi Arabia to extend the airport suspension and vow a deadly response. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards are identified as the likely source of threats against RAF Fairford and have been blamed for an airbase plot, leading the UK to sanction two Iranian nationals. Iran is fortifying nuclear sites and rallying its people for a return to fighting, while its oil intermediaries owe the government billions. The conflict has expanded into Iranian waters with an oil tanker attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and a supertanker mine strike prompting IRGC retaliation. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthi-missiler har rammet Riyadh flyplass gjentatte ganger, drept tolv og såret mange, noe som har fått Saudi-Arabia til å forlenge suspensjonen av flyplassen og love et dødelig svar. Irans revolusjonsgarden er identifisert som sannsynlig kilde til trusler mot RAF Fairford og er blitt anklaget for en plan mot en flybase, noe som har ført til at Storbritannia har sanksjonert to iranske statsborgere. Iran styrker nukleare anlegg og mobiliserer folket for en retur til kamp, mens landets oljeintermediærer skylder regjeringen milliarder. Konflikten har utvidet seg til iranske farvann med et oljetankerangrep i Hormuzstredet og et supertanker-mineangrep som har utløst IRGCs gjengjeldelse. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli drones struck a Syrian operative planning attacks for Iran near the Lebanon border, while Houthi forces attacked Riyadh's King Khalid Airport, killing 12 and injuring 309. Syrian security forces intensified anti-ISIS operations, pursued former regime loyalists, and engaged private security firms linked to a new Syrian security mogul, while also foiling drug-smuggling attempts on the Iraq and Jordan borders. The UN Security Council discussed the situation, urging Israel to respect the 1974 Disengagement Agreement and calling for an end to Israeli incursions into southern Syria. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN-sikkerhetsrådet diskuterte situasjonen, oppfordret Israel til å respektere avtalen fra 1974 om tilbaketrekning og ba om en slutt på israelske inntrengninger i sørlige Syria. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have carried out air strikes on gold mining sites on the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners. The Rapid Support Forces have used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, causing additional casualties. These attacks extend fighting into civilian mining areas and the border triangle region, threatening civilians in West Kordofan. The war has already produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Disse angrepene utvider kampene til sivile gruveområder og trekantregionen ved grensen, og truer sivilbefolkningen i Vest-Kordofan. Krigen har allerede forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
